task_description: Implement Option B: Canonical Structured Knowledge architecture for the Syrabit.ai educational platform. This includes a KnowledgeObject Beanie model, content pipeline service (HTML rendering, Azure Search indexing, MCQ/summary generation, IndexNow, Cloudflare KV), public content API, admin CRUD/publish API, sitemap generation, and ISR support.

verification.summary: 47 tests all pass after review fixes. Addressed: Jinja2 autoescape double-escaping, public endpoint security (is_published filter + field exclusion), sitemap projection optimization, admin input validation (ValidationError -> 422).
